title: zephyranthes bahiensis

The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's therapeutic actions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
